title: Crew Roster
summary: Translate SPSS Aggregate: collapse the mission log to one row per astronaut and count the spacewalkers.
hints: Fix the nationalities first with `case_when()`, exactly as in Typo Patrol.

SPSS's BREAK variable is the `group_by()`: `group_by(number) |> summarise(name = first(name), sex = first(sex), nationality = first(nationality), missions = n(), total_hours = sum(hours_mission), eva_hours = sum(eva_hrs_mission))`.
A spacewalker has `eva_hours > 0`: `sum(roster$eva_hours > 0)`, and the percentage is that divided by `nrow(roster)`, times 100, rounded to 1 decimal.

dialog.label: Summaries of Variable(s)
dialog.value: name = FIRST(name), sex = FIRST(sex), nationality = FIRST(nationality), missions = N, total_hours = SUM(hours_mission), eva_hours = SUM(eva_hrs_mission)

spss.syntax:
DATASET DECLARE roster.
AGGREGATE
  /OUTFILE='roster'
  /BREAK=number
  /name=FIRST(name)
  /sex=FIRST(sex)
  /nationality=FIRST(nationality)
  /missions=N
  /total_hours=SUM(hours_mission)
  /eva_hours=SUM(eva_hrs_mission).
DATASET ACTIVATE roster.
COMPUTE spacewalker = eva_hours > 0.
FREQUENCIES VARIABLES=spacewalker.
